integrity: Analytic argument uses the previously established Jacobi block representation with new Jacobi leakage and counting arguments; finite numerical tests are supplementary, and external certification is not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Fixed polyanalytic order n>=2, fixed alpha>-1, bounded real radial functions of squared radius having C2 boundary germs; sharp p threshold only when the boundary derivative determinant is nonzero. Historical priority provisional; no independent validation.
title: Cubic boundary commutator law and the sharp Schatten threshold in polyanalytic Bergman spaces
